sourceManifestCanonicalization.bomRule: remove one leading UTF-8 BOM if present
sourceManifestCanonicalization.lineEndingRule: normalize CRLF and lone CR to LF
sourceManifestCanonicalization.contentRule: preserve all other text, whitespace, JSON property order, indentation, and final newline

evidenceMethod: Offline static SHA-256 equality against exact C0 deps-referenced NuGet/runtime-pack cache files; C0 deps project ownership for compiled project outputs; exact source SHA-256 for runtime prompts; retained C0 publish metadata for apphost/deps/runtimeconfig.

classificationDefinitions.package: Exact frozen file SHA-256 equals a file under one C0 deps-referenced NuGet package/version.
classificationDefinitions.runtime: Exact frozen file SHA-256 equals a file under one C0 deps-referenced runtime pack/version.
classificationDefinitions.project-owned: C0 deps identifies a project output, or exact C0 source file SHA-256 equals the frozen file.
classificationDefinitions.build-derived: C0 project publish-generated apphost, deps metadata, or runtime configuration.
classificationDefinitions.container-only: Reserved for installer-container-only evidence; count is zero because this file covers installedPayload only.
classificationDefinitions.unknown: No exact bounded evidence; retained as unmapped rather than inferred.

limitations: This evidence maps frozen files to bounded source/package/build origins; it does not establish full license clearance, legal advice, NOTICE placement, signing, or distribution approval.

C0 deps package contentHash values match C0 lock metadata, but all 43 current local cache .nupkg.sha512 values differ; package-file attribution is therefore file-level SHA-256 evidence and must not be presented as current cache container identity equality.
Compiled project DLL ownership uses exact C0 deps project entries and output identities, not a reproducible source-to-binary hash proof.
Build-derived apphost/deps/runtimeconfig records use retained C0 publish/project metadata; no frozen binary was executed.
Installer container entries are not extracted or covered; container-only remains zero.
NuGet cache locations are recorded only as normalized logical relative paths; no machine absolute paths or credentials are recorded.
